sources.snippet: Underdog-27B-1.0 Underdog-27B by Conway is a 27-billion-parameter model for conversation, writing, coding, and everyday assistance. Its MLX 4-bit QAT weights pair with Splash's speculative decoding for responsive local generation on Apple Silicon. We finetuned this model to run better in Underdog for human users, based on Qwen3.8.
